plan.estimand: Main effect of 3-level factor in balanced 3-by-2 factorial ANOVA with all 6 cells independent and full interaction model
plan.hypothesis: H₀: All 3 levels of the factor have equal mean; H₁: At least one level mean differs (non-directed alternative)

parameters.name: Number of levels in factor A (rows)
Number of levels in factor B (columns)

assumptions: Balanced design: equal sample size n per cell (6 cells total)
All 6 cells have independent observations
Full interaction model fitted (A, B, A×B effects)
Common variance assumption (homogeneity of variance across cells)
Normality of residuals within each cell
Effect size expressed as partial eta-squared = 0.06 for the 3-level factor main effect
Total sample size N = 6n (n participants per cell × 6 cells)
Denominator degrees of freedom df_error = N − 6 = 6n − 6
Test statistic: F with df_num = 2, df_denom = 6n − 6
scientific_notes: Partial eta-squared (η_p²) for a main effect in a factorial design is related to non-centrality parameter via the full interaction model with error df = N − ab where a=3, b=2, ab=6
Conversion from partial eta-squared to non-centrality: λ = [η_p² / (1 − η_p²)] × df_error
For sample-size inversion, iteratively solve for minimum integer n such that Power(F; df1=2, df2=6n−6, λ(n)) ≥ 0.80
Will use non-central F distribution for power calculation
Rounding convention: return smallest integer n ≥ continuous solution that achieves target power
